messages:
olga: FYI getting a small wave of SCIM 403s right after the infra role prune. Deprovision retries are looping for a few tenants, KMS logs show Decrypt denied.

pete: timeline? which merge touched roles?

olga: PR #5234 merged 2026-05-07T11:07 UTC. Errors begin ~11:09. Connector logs show: 
```
2026-05-07T11:09:12Z ERROR scim-provisioner err="KMS: decrypt failed: AccessDenied" extid=acct-77 req=abc
2026-05-07T11:09:13Z WARN  scim-provisioner deprov_retry=1 idp_resp=403
```

quinn: sounds like the service role lost kms:Decrypt. Which principal is the connector assuming?

olga: k8s SA `idp-scim` -> IAM role `idp-scim-role`. CloudTrail shows `iam:DetachRolePolicy` at 11:06:45 by infra-automation.

sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED principal=arn:aws:sts::555555555555:assumed-role/idp-scim-role/2026-05-07T11:09:12Z (hits=5)

pete: mitigation: temporarily reattach minimal kms:Decrypt to idp-scim-role scoped to alias/scim-mappings and add condition `aws:PrincipalTag/role=scim`. Timebox it.

olga: applying now, patch applied at 11:11:03 UTC. Will monitor.

sec-bot: POLICY_CHANGE: key alias/scim-mappings policy updated by olga (console) at 2026-05-07T11:11:03Z

quinn: scim logs: 11:11:45 `200 OK deprovision extid=acct-77`. Backlog decreasing. Good.

compliance: emergency policy changes must include approver + audit snapshot uploaded. Please record approvals.

pete: uploading CloudTrail slice and key-policy snapshot to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-521-scim-rbac. Opening INC-2026-521 and tagging sec-eng + compliance.

olga: short postmortem items: root cause = RBAC prune detached policy used by connector; contributing = no infra guardrail for roles tagged service-account; actions = add pre-merge CI check to flag policy removals affecting roles with tag `service-account=true`, add IAM deny guardrail for deleting tagged roles, schedule mapping rewrap (per-record) rather than CMK rotation.

quinn: question: rotate CMK or rewrap data keys? prefer rewrap to minimize blast radius.

pete: agree rewrap. We'll create a migration job that GenerateDataKey and re-encrypt records.

olga: temporary decrypt grant will be auto-revoked in 90 minutes by revoke-lambda. Schedules set.

sec-bot: SCHEDULED_TASK: revoke-temp-kms-policy at 2026-05-07T12:41:03Z

quinn: run a scan for half-deprovisioned rows: `SELECT extid,status,last_attempt FROM scim_mappings WHERE status!='deleted' AND last_attempt > '2026-05-07T10:50:00Z'` -> 4 rows; reconciled 3 manually, 1 queued.

pete: added follow-ups to INC-2026-521: CI rule, IAM guardrail, mapping rewrap job, postmortem writeup, timeline + approvals.

olga: thanks team. Closing emergency when audit bundle attached to incident. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
